mapper.select: SELECT s.*, s1.nick_name AS fromNickName, s1.avatar AS fromAvatar, s2.nick_name AS toNickName, s2.avatar AS toAvatar, IF(FIND_IN_SET(#{formUser}, s.top_hx_ids ), 1, 2 ) AS isTop, m.group_name as groupName FROM session_list s LEFT JOIN msg_group_info m ON m.to_group = s.session_id and m.del=1 LEFT JOIN sys_user s1 ON s.form_user_id = s1.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user s2 ON s.to_user_id = s2.user_id WHERE s.del=1 and FIND_IN_SET(#{formUser}, s.belong_hx_ids) and to_days(now())-to_days(coalesce(s.update_time,s.create_time)) <= #{day} ORDER BY s.update_time DESC

SELECT s.*, s1.nick_name AS fromNickName, s1.avatar AS fromAvatar, s2.nick_name AS toNickName, s2.avatar AS toAvatar, 1 AS isTop, m.group_name as groupName FROM session_list s LEFT JOIN msg_group_info m ON m.to_group = s.session_id and m.del=1 LEFT JOIN sys_user s1 ON s.form_user_id = s1.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user s2 ON s.to_user_id = s2.user_id WHERE s.del=1 and FIND_IN_SET(#{formUser}, s.belong_hx_ids) and FIND_IN_SET(#{formUser}, s.top_hx_ids) ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
